about: The only colors a diagram may use. Dark mode only. Every color that may be used for words reaches 4.5 to 1 on every surface, and every border and accent reaches 3 to 1 on every surface (the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines, version 2.2, rules 1.4.3 and 1.4.11). tests/palette.test.mjs proves both.

background.use: The whole canvas. Always the first shape, covering everything.

surface.use: The fill of an ordinary box.

raised.use: The fill of a box that should stand out, or a group panel behind boxes.

muted.use: Second lines, notes and legend words.

border.use: Ordinary box edges, arrows and lines.

blue.use: The main path, or the good side of a good and bad pair.

orange.use: Warnings, or the bad side of a good and bad pair.

green.use: Done or passing, always with a word that says so.

red.use: Stopped or failing, always with a word that says so.

purple.use: A second group or a person.

teal.use: A third group, or data and storage.
